title: One Benefit, Many Ways to Support Employees
summary: Papa provides real-life support, from caregiving to helping with daily tasks, so employees can focus on work while knowing home is handled.
body_markdown: Take Julie, for example. Julie is a small business owner who not only leads a team, but like many of us, is a member of the “sandwich generation,” caring for both children and aging loved ones. She knows firsthand how hard it is to juggle work and life, and understands how much of a difference even a few hours of help can make.
